The education ministry's SNDECI 2024-2028 says DOBCONNECT was started in January 2024 in 5 pilot establishments of the Abidjan regional directorates (DRENA), with its general rollout due in May 2024, a step the strategy gives as still to come; the level of the 5 establishments is not stated.
